policy.resetRepositoryDesc: This can rewrite history and discard uncommitted work depending on the selected reset mode.
policy.deleteUntrackedFilesDesc: This permanently deletes the listed untracked files from the repository.
policy.dropStashDesc: This permanently removes the selected stash entry.
policy.deleteBranchDesc: This permanently deletes the selected local branch or branches.
policy.removeWorktreeDesc: This removes the selected worktree directory from Git management.
policy.deleteTagDesc: This permanently removes the selected local Git tag.
policy.applyPatchDesc: This writes the patch changes into the repository working tree and may create conflicts.
policy.rewriteHistoryDesc: This rewrites commit history and should not be used on shared commits without coordination.
policy.revertCommitDesc: This creates a new commit that undoes the selected commit's changes.
policy.forcePushDesc: This rewrites the remote branch with --force-with-lease. Commits that exist only on the remote are discarded unless they match the remote-tracking ref.
policy.deleteRemoteBranchDesc: This permanently deletes the selected branch on the remote.
policy.cherryPickCommitsDesc: This applies commits to the current branch and may create conflicts.
policy.runBatchGitOperationDesc: This writes repository state across every listed project. Review the exact project set before continuing.
policy.unknownPolicy: No destructive-operation policy is registered for '{{operation}}'
policy.emptyImpact: A destructive operation must name at least one affected target
